auth_leaked_password_protection.rationale: Temporarily accepted for Phase 15 because provider leaked-password screening is not enabled; enable it and re-run the advisor before the next security release.

rls_enabled_no_policy.rationale: Accepted for these exact fingerprints because the affected tables are intentionally deny-by-default or service-role/RPC controlled; adding permissive policies would weaken that boundary.

unindexed_foreign_keys.rationale: Temporarily accepted for Phase 15 with exact fingerprints retained; measure production query plans and add only justified indexes in the scheduled performance follow-up.

unused_index.rationale: Accepted because resettable advisor usage statistics and release-time inactivity do not prove an index is safe to remove; retain these exact indexes until a workload review.
